body:
Resolved the real, standing design question (founder, real-time: CANCELLED dispatches Regulators who delete you with acid and foam) by checking it against and confirming it matches existing canon (docs/DESIGN_DIGEST.md §11's Corporate Service Call + somatic-clone respawn lore) rather than inventing fresh. Split into Phase A (built: real Decorum math -- costume/zone/noticed wired live using already-tested core/witness_rules.c logic) and Phase B (named, deferred: Regulator dispatch, real player death, clone respawn, Bio-Slurry economy -- each a genuinely separate unscoped subsystem). New server-authoritative costume/decorum fields on PcPlayerState, PC_PACKET_COSTUME_SET, server_tick_decorum firing zone_access/conspicuousness/noticed once per zone-entry transition against real nearby NPC vigilance, new seeded server RNG. Reaching CANCELLED logs honestly instead of faking a consequence. Client STATUS screen shows real costume/decorum/band now. bigo_phone_test extended; new scratch #include-main.c harness proves the real server functions end to end, 6/6 pass. bazel test //... 36/36 green, ASan/UBSan + client build clean, live server re-verified. NORTHSTAR.md §18, README.md, CHANGELOG.md; GOLDEN_DOCS resynced.

⚓ ☃
